sloka: तस्मै दृढतरं क्रुद्धो जघान गदया हयान्।विभीषणो महातेजा रावणेः स दुरात्मनः ।। ६.९१.४१ ।।
transliteration: tasmai dṛḍhataraṁ kruddho jaghāna gadayā hayān।vibhīṣaṇo mahātejā rāvaṇeḥ sa durātmanaḥ ।। 6.91.41 ।।

translations.english: Having struck Vibheeshana with three arrows, he struck again all the Vanara leaders with one arrow each.
